storyCards.headline: Ruby Don't Take Your Love To Town: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Kenny Rogers's "Ruby Don't Take Your Love To Town" reached #6 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #6 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 13 weeks on the chart.

Ruby Don't Take Your Love To Town was released in 1969.
